headline: BJP MP calls for reclaiming Noakhali, Chittagong Port, and Sylhet from Bangladesh
summary: Lawmaker Nishikant Dubey claims these territories were handed over to East Pakistan during Partition without the consent of the Tripura kingdom's ruler.
details: Indian BJP lawmaker Nishikant Dubey has called for India to "reclaim" Noakhali, Chittagong Port, and Sylhet from Bangladesh.
Dubey claimed these territories were handed over to East Pakistan during the 1947 Partition without the consent of the ruler of the erstwhile Tripura kingdom.
He blamed India's first prime minister, Jawaharlal Nehru, alleging that Nehru agreed to leave the three regions out of India to secure the Muslim League's support in the 1946 interim government.
Dubey stated that the time has come to reclaim these territories, comparing the move to reclaiming Pakistan-occupied Kashmir.
The remarks were backed by Pradyot Manikya, head of the Tipra Motha party and a descendant of Tripura's royal family.
Manikya argued that the loss of Chattogram has left northeastern India geographically constrained and without direct sea access, referring to the 'Chicken's Neck' corridor.
Dubey further cited the former king of Tripura, Bir Bikram Kishore Manikya, who had reportedly opposed the decision and challenged Nehru over the future of the regions.

headline: Midterms rout: Trump retains grip on foreign policy despite losses
summary: Despite Democrats capturing both chambers of Congress, analysts say the US President is likely to maintain broad authority over international affairs.
details: President Donald Trump faces a weakened domestic position after Republicans suffered sweeping losses in the midterm elections, with Democrats now controlling both chambers of Congress.
Democratic leaders, including Senate leader Chuck Schumer, have pledged greater oversight of Trump's agenda to curb what they describe as "chaos at home and abroad."
Democrats' priorities include ending the war with Iran, restoring support for Ukraine, and reassessing US policy toward Israel, though they face the challenge of presidential vetoes.
Analysts from the Atlantic Council and Middle East Institute suggest that foreign affairs remain an area where presidents wield extensive constitutional powers as commander-in-chief.
The conflict with Iran remains the most urgent challenge, with Trump defending his strikes on Tehran to prevent nuclear weapon acquisition despite public fatigue and rising fuel prices.
Internal Republican friction has emerged, with Vice President JD Vance publicly questioning the cost of the Iran conflict and blaming it for the party's election defeat.
Congress is also expected to take a tougher stance on Israel, with progressive Democrats pushing for greater scrutiny of Israeli actions in Gaza and the West Bank.
As he enters a lame-duck phase, analysts believe Trump will focus heavily on international affairs to shape his global legacy, regardless of whether that imprint is positive.
caption:
Democrats now control Congress, but can they stop Trump's foreign policy?

Analysts say the President still holds the keys to global affairs.

President Donald Trump faces a weakened domestic position after Republicans suffered sweeping losses in the midterm elections, with Democrats now controlling both chambers of Congress.

Democratic leaders, including Senate leader Chuck Schumer, have pledged greater oversight of Trump's agenda to curb what they describe as "chaos at home and abroad."

Democrats' priorities include ending the war with Iran, restoring support for Ukraine, and reassessing US policy toward Israel, though they face the challenge of presidential vetoes.

Analysts from the Atlantic Council and Middle East Institute suggest that foreign affairs remain an area where presidents wield extensive constitutional powers as commander-in-chief.

The conflict with Iran remains the most urgent challenge, with Trump defending his strikes on Tehran to prevent nuclear weapon acquisition despite public fatigue and rising fuel prices.

Internal Republican friction has emerged, with Vice President JD Vance publicly questioning the cost of the Iran conflict and blaming it for the party's election defeat.

Congress is also expected to take a tougher stance on Israel, with progressive Democrats pushing for greater scrutiny of Israeli actions in Gaza and the West Bank.

As he enters a lame-duck phase, analysts believe Trump will focus heavily on international affairs to shape his global legacy, regardless of whether that imprint is positive.
